messages.subject: Okafor ET — hearing bundle deadline
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom — separately on the Okafor tribunal claim, the Tribunal has listed the preliminary hearing and the bundle is due three weeks before. Can someone confirm we're on track with the ET3 and the schedule of loss responses? Not urgent for the Vholes matter, just don't want it to slip.

Daniel
